installAgentPrompt: Seta i-HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) kule khompyutha. Faka i-HAX CLI nge-`npm install @haxtheweb/create --global`, emva koko ufake izakhono zayo ze-arhente nge-`hax skills install --all`. Yenza isayithi nge-`hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i`, uyiqalise nge-`cd my-hax-site && hax serve`, uze undixelele idilesi eyiprintayo. Funda i-AGENTS.md yesayithi kunye ne-https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe nantoni na.
